'''Mashera Donavelle''' was an [[Aes Sedai]].

==History==
[[Faile]] mentions [[Jestian Redhill]], [[Isebaille Tobanyi]] and Mashera Donavelle as examples of Aes Sedai who would do anything the [[White Tower]] told them to do. Mashera bore seven children for a man she loathed.

Other than Elayne, she is the only reference we have to an Aes Sedai becoming pregnant.
